editorial.blurb: This no-frills Little Vietnam gem serves deeply authentic Vietnamese comfort food, with pho that draws loyal families back year after year for its hearty broth and generous portions.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the House Special pho for maximum value and variety—it layers flank, brisket, tendon, meatballs, and tripe into one deeply satisfying bowl, and it's conveniently accessible via the Red Line.
